flow.action.badRequest.note: Shown in Shopify Flow when the action request is malformed.

flow.action.notInstalled.note: Shown in Shopify Flow when the app is uninstalled.

flow.action.planRequired.note: Shown in Shopify Flow on lower plans. {plan} = plan name.

flow.action.notFound.note: Shown in Shopify Flow when the application ID is wrong.

flow.action.alreadyApproved.note: Shown in Shopify Flow when nothing needed doing.

flow.action.tierNotFound.note: Shown in Shopify Flow. {tier} = name entered in the action.

flow.action.noTier.note: Shown in Shopify Flow when no tier can be chosen.

flow.action.running.note: Shown in Shopify Flow while the approval runs.

flow.action.stepFailed.note: Shown in Shopify Flow when the approval fails.

flow.action.tryLater.note: Shown in Shopify Flow on a temporary error.
